answer: Each agent bonds stake to an epoch-scoped RLN identity and commits to a polynomial whose evaluations authenticate rate-limited messages. A Semaphore-style membership proof hides identity, while a nullifier binds each message to its epoch. Reusing that nullifier on distinct messages exposes two Shamir shares; interpolation reveals the private key, enabling verification of the violation and immediate collateral slashing. Ember, reef, and raven may act pseudonymously, but cannot message twice within the limit.
